delete.description:
part16 §15.3 (Phase 12) — the model registry's deletion lane.

Evicts one session-trained model from the bounded registry (the
in-memory record plus, through ``ModelStore._forget``, the
persisted ``trained_models`` row and its vault payload when the
durability lane is on — the same channel the artifacts' evict
lane rides, never a bespoke second deletion path).  The response
carries the evicted id and the remaining count so the GUI can
refresh honestly without a second listing call.

keep their ``model_artifact`` references (the §15.2 lineage
outlives the model — the record's ``fetch`` pointer degrades to
the honest 404, never rewritten), exported joblib artifacts are
independent copies that survive, and the dataset the model was
trained on is untouched.  An unknown id is a 404, never a silent
no-op.

DriftRequest.title: DriftRequest
DriftRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/ml/drift — ML-5's distribution-shift body.

Exactly one reference source: the training dataset of a
session-trained model (``model_id`` — the re-scoring lane the
roadmap names) or a registered dataset (``dataset_id``).  The
current batch is always a registered dataset (``new_dataset_id``).

DrugResponseAnalyzeRequest.title: DrugResponseAnalyzeRequest
DrugResponseAnalyzeRequest.description:
One seeded synthetic screen + fit + ranking request.

The geometry bounds mirror the backend's own rules exactly
(``>= 4`` cells, ``>= 2`` drugs, ``>= 2`` features, ``2 <=
n_folds <= n_cells`` — the last one enforced by the backend
itself as its own 422); the remaining caps are this route's
sync-light budget, stated in the registry.

DtaPairRow.title: DtaPairRow
DtaPairRow.description:
One drug--target pair: a SMILES ligand, a protein sequence, and
an optional affinity value (the column the backend validates as
finite numeric at source rows when any row carries it).

FactorSpecModel.title: FactorSpecModel
FactorSpecModel.description: One declared factor: name, range, optional unit.

FitRsmRequest.title: FitRsmRequest
FitRsmRequest.description:
The §6.4 fit contract over an observed frame.

``dataset_id`` selects a registered typed dataset whose factor
columns carry the OBSERVED actual levels and whose response
columns carry the measured results; leaving it None rides the
seeded SYNTHETIC demo experiment (labelled).  The factor ranges
are the request's own declared ranges (the coding transform rides
them); the optional design block records which design produced
the rows (the zone vocabulary's axial region needs the CCD's
alpha).

FramesRegisterRequest.title: FramesRegisterRequest
FramesRegisterRequest.description:
DS-3 -- the Descriptor/Fingerprint stage's missing verb.

Registers the computed descriptor frame or fingerprint matrix as a
NEW derived dataset through the same load-and-register path every
upload takes. The engine re-reads the source record's SMILES
column server-side (row-aligned with the source frame -- the one
source of truth), computes the REAL features through
:func:`pharmaml.chem.descriptors.compute_descriptors` /
:func:`compute_fingerprints`, and appends the feature columns to a
staged copy of the source frame: every source column (the target
included) rides the derived dataset, so the ML/DL workspaces can
train over the featurized matrix directly -- the classical
SMILES -> descriptors -> model loop, closed inside the GUI.

``target`` is optional: ``None`` inherits the source record's own
target; an explicit override must name an existing source column
(the task is then re-inferred at load time). The source record is
never mutated; rows the engine rejects (unparseable, or a
per-molecule descriptor failure) leave the derived frame but ride
the response's ``rejected`` list -- never silently dropped.

GnnGraphSpec.title: GnnGraphSpec
GnnGraphSpec.description: One graph: node features + the 2×E source→destination endpoints.

target.title: Target
target.description: Target column override; None = the curated hint (if any) then the loader's auto-detection.

task.title: Task
task.description: Task hint override ('classification' / 'regression'); None = the curated hint (if any) then auto-inference.

LoadRequest.title: LoadRequest
LoadRequest.description:
Optional knobs for the tabular import (mirroring the upload form).

The curated defaults (target/task hints per sample) are applied
when the request omits them; ``None`` explicitly defers to the
REAL loader's auto-detection, exactly like an upload that leaves
the fields blank.

MultiObjectiveOptimizeRequest.title: MultiObjectiveOptimizeRequest
MultiObjectiveOptimizeRequest.description:
One seeded synthetic study: dataset + space + model + objectives.

The dataset is the route's own seeded 80x6 SYNTHETIC stand-in (the
seed is the only generative dial); the space is the request's own
dimension specs (1..4); the model is any sklearn registry name the
backend itself validates; the objectives are 2..3 distinct entries
from the backend's own ledger.  ``weight_mode`` /
``n_weight_vectors`` are the study's own spread dials, forwarded
verbatim.  The default study (random_forest over n_estimators x
max_depth) carries a real trade-off: accuracy climbs with depth
while fit seconds climb with the tree count.

PharmacogenomicsAnalyzeRequest.title: PharmacogenomicsAnalyzeRequest
PharmacogenomicsAnalyzeRequest.description:
One seeded synthetic screen + ANOVA + baseline-evaluation request.

The screen geometry is the backend's own demo contract (40 cell
lines x 12 drugs x 10 binary features, ~15 % untested); the seed
is the only generative dial.  ``include_msi`` mirrors
``gdsc_anova``'s own parameter (the MSI factor rides the design
matrix when both sides carry ``>= 2`` lines).

PredictMultiResponseRequest.title: PredictMultiResponseRequest
PredictMultiResponseRequest.description: Inline rows -> multi-column predictions in the contract order.

PredictRsmRequest.title: PredictRsmRequest
PredictRsmRequest.description: Point rows (actual units) -> per-response predictions + CI/PI.

PreferenceValue.title: PreferenceValue
PreferenceValue.description: One preference write — any strict-JSON-safe value.

QualityRequest.title: QualityRequest
QualityRequest.description:
The §15.4 scan's knobs: column overrides + execution mode.

``smiles_column`` left null = the honest auto-detection; an
explicit name overrides it (an empty string disables the
chemistry pair). ``target`` left null = the record's own target.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: the trained run's policy table (state id -> action id)

RepurposingScreenRequest.title: RepurposingScreenRequest
RepurposingScreenRequest.description:
One seeded synthetic screen + fit + ranking request.

The geometry bounds mirror the backend's own rules exactly
(``>= 4`` cells, ``>= 3`` drugs, ``>= 2`` features, ``observed``
in ``[0.3, 1.0]``); the remaining caps are this route's sync-light
budget, stated in the registry.

RlOptimizeRequest.title: RlOptimizeRequest
RlOptimizeRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/generative/rl-optimize — the molecular RL body.

The objective spec rides the SAME vocabulary the GA lane and the
prior-train lane serve (``_build_objective`` — one builder, one
catalog, never a second scoring authority); the prior is a
session-trained molecular RNN prior (``prior_id``) or the
engine's own on-the-fly prior over an inline corpus (or the
engine's DEFAULT_CORPUS when neither is given).

mask_fraction.title: Mask Fraction
mask_fraction.description: carve this fraction of labels out as unlabeled (seeded); omit when the target column already carries the marker

base_estimator.title: Base Estimator
base_estimator.description: registry classification model backing self-training (must expose predict_proba; default LogisticRegression)

SpaceDimension.title: SpaceDimension
SpaceDimension.description:
One dimension of the search space, in the backend's own terms.

``uniform`` / ``loguniform`` build a ``FloatParam`` on
``[low, high]`` (the log sampling inside); ``randint`` builds an
``IntParam`` on the inclusive integer range.  The name must be one
of the model's own hyperparameters — the backend's
``build_model`` raises its typed ``ModelError`` otherwise (a 422,
never a 500).

SplitRequest.title: SplitRequest
SplitRequest.description:
The split lane's knobs (DS-1: the engine's strategy vocabulary).

``strategy=None`` keeps the legacy ``split_table`` path exactly as
it has always answered (the ``stratify`` boolean decides random vs
stratified, with target auto-detection). Setting ``strategy``
routes the split through :func:`pharmaml.ml.splits.split_indices`
-- the same engine the CLI and the ML templates already use --
adding the scaffold (Bemis-Murcko groups held out whole), group
(explicit labels), kennard_stone and temporal strategies the
legacy lane cannot express. ``smiles_column`` is the scaffold
lane's input (auto-detected when omitted); ``group_column`` is the
group lane's input (required there, never guessed).

StandardizeRequest.title: StandardizeRequest
StandardizeRequest.description:
DS-2 -- the Clean stage's missing verb, over the REAL engine.

``ops`` is the ordered list of standardization passes, each a real
:mod:`pharmaml.chem.standardize` callable applied in sequence:

* ``"canonical_tautomer"`` -- the REINVENT ligprep pipeline's
  TautomerEnumerator pass (keto/enol forms collapse to one);
* ``"reinvent"`` -- the REINVENT4 ``default`` chain (largest
  fragment -> RemoveHs -> salt removal -> neutralisation -> cleanup
  -> unwanted-pattern/size/element gates).

``neutralize`` toggles the chain's own step-4 pass (the engine's
documented knob; honoured only when ``"reinvent"`` rides ``ops``).
The standardized frame registers as a NEW dataset with full
provenance (``derived`` block: source id + column + ops); the
source record is never mutated. Rows the engine rejects are NOT
silently dropped: they leave the derived frame but ride the
response's ``rejected`` list (row, input, reason).

TrainMultiResponseRequest.title: TrainMultiResponseRequest
TrainMultiResponseRequest.description:
The §5.4 input contract over a real frame.

``dataset_id`` selects a registered typed dataset; leaving it None
rides the seeded SYNTHETIC demo frame (labelled).  Features and
>=2 numeric targets are the request's own column selections.  The
missing-value strategy, the split/CV configuration, per-target
scaling, preprocessing, the strategy key + its hyperparameters,
the sample-weight column, and the target-weight vector all ride
this one body -- each validated by the backend's own typed errors.

TrainSplitSpec.title: TrainSplitSpec
TrainSplitSpec.description:
ML-3 -- the Train lane's split section (the roadmap's row 2).

The same engine vocabulary DS-1 exposed at the Datasets stage
(``pharmaml.ml.splits``), now riding ``POST /ml/train``: with
``split`` set, the route carves a held-out side through
:func:`pharmaml.ml.splits.split_indices` BEFORE the fit -- the
training frame the estimator sees is the carved train side, and the
carve itself (the two sides, the per-side group census and the
``shared_groups`` leakage verdict) is reported in the train
response and in the §15.2 run record's ``cross_validation.split``
block at both exits.  ``smiles_column`` left null = the honest
auto-detection (scaffold); ``group_column`` is the group lane's
required input, never guessed (the DS-1 prerequisites verbatim).

n_components.title: N Components
n_components.description: component count; omit to keep the engine's own cap min(10, n_samples, n_features)

UnsupervisedPcaRequest.title: UnsupervisedPcaRequest
UnsupervisedPcaRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/unsupervised/pca — the ML-4 PCA sibling.

The unique component name follows the family's anti-collision
